claim_text: The operator's registered prior. Recorded 2026-08-25, before any module touched the sealed store.

claim_text: block = 2 * cfg.primary_horizon_sessions applied at the secondary horizon as well as the primary
data_first_existed: all outcome data by 19:46:42Z; the sealed store since 16:54:33Z

The registration fixes block length only as 'a moving-block bootstrap whose expected block length is 10 sessions, twice the primary horizon' (REGISTRATION.md:143-144) and says nothing about the secondary.
